scopeLabel: Source-scoped PbSe ink and ZnO nanoparticle syntheses, two precursor stocks, ZnO/electrode preparation, PbSe/ZnO device fabrication, four partial ink-concentration variants, pristine-device control and two air-storage contexts. Main 7 and SI 12 pages read in text and images. Representative characterization and device metrics do not establish exact physical batch identity. Missing recipe settings, ambiguous precursor names and conflicting printed values remain explicit; this is not a complete laboratory SOP or full-paper narrative review.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
